en: The postcard features a historical black-and-white photograph of a lively street café scene, with people sitting outdoors at tables under tall trees in front of a large building. Visible signage reads 'Café Landwehrmann' and other German texts such as 'Conditorei' and 'Gebrüder Struck HERREN-MODE'. The postcard also contains the caption 'Bad Pyrmont' at the bottom and the address side includes a Deutsches Reich postage stamp and penned German handwriting, as well as a blue stamp for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
